title: Fridge Sensor Fault
fullDescription: E1 on Candy refrigerators indicates the fridge temperature sensor has failed. Control loses ability to regulate compressor.

title: Freezer Sensor Fault
fullDescription: E2 indicates the freezer temperature sensor has failed.

title: Evaporator Sensor Fault
fullDescription: E3 indicates evaporator NTC failure, leading to ice build-up.

title: Defrost Heater Fault
fullDescription: E4 means the defrost heater element or bi-metal has failed.

title: Fan Fault
fullDescription: E5 indicates circulation fan failure — iced or dead motor.

title: Compressor Fault
fullDescription: E6 indicates compressor not starting. Relay or compressor failure.

title: Door Ajar Alarm
fullDescription: E7 indicates door open beyond alarm threshold or failed switch.

title: High Temperature Alarm
fullDescription: E8 triggers when the fridge cannot maintain setpoint — long door-open, overload, or sealed system issue.

title: Damper Fault
fullDescription: E9 indicates the fridge air damper is stuck or its motor has failed.

title: Control Board Fault
fullDescription: E10 indicates main PCB or EEPROM failure. Try power cycle; otherwise replace PCB.
